versionSources.v1: 20260917-v1-r05; original full-height glass, exterior arc seating, whole-home R04 adjustments

guestBathGB04.basis: D023 all-version original-position guest bathroom storage. Remaining 175 image slots retained from earlier revisions. Only identical source PNG hashes share AI assets.

modelRepairMR01.basis: MR01 consultant model proposal: entries, storage retrieval, V3 audio route, sliding shower glass, door geometry and hollow kitchen sink. V0 unchanged. Only identical model PNG pixels share images.

allVersionsQA03.scope: V0–V4; 190 fixed gallery cameras, 12 rooms; source mesh checks and sampled V1–V4 motion
allVersionsQA03.basis: Fill missing wall areas outside existing windows; V0 hollow kitchen sink. Existing wall/window positions retained. Window sill/head are inherited model assumptions, pending approved elevations. Native AI individually generated and reviewed; shared only when source PNG pixels match.

GR06.basis: Gray stone focal surface, gray-brown herringbone floor; existing geometry retained. Five source cameras per room and version. Native AI shared only for identical source pixels.

V4-R02.basis: Owner accepted 45cm living group shift, rack-supported rear enclosure proxies and two island stools; V2 retired to history. Dimensions/engineering remain to verify.

V4-GI01.basis: Owner accepted gray-stone modern industrial refinement: graphite cabinet fronts, brushed gunmetal details and zoned lighting. R02 geometry retained.
V4-GI01.limits: Source rasterizer omits physical lighting; study-D explicitly regenerated for lighting despite identical pixels.

BI01.basis: Accepted matte-black ceiling, medium-gray walls, graphite joinery, gray stone and gray-brown herringbone. All five layouts retained; all 300 AI slots replaced with newly generated and reviewed images.
